nonBlockingIssues.description: Redundant debug logging in yaml.py: duplicate detection logs both in _normalize_and_verify_yaml() and _deduplicate_yaml_data() for the same allele.
VAL-GEN-007 (make_airr_database build test) is claimed as fulfilled but not explicitly tested — only YamlRef loading is verified. Database build is slow and better tested at integration level.
Redundant GermlineManager instantiation in generate.py:_get_all_alleles_for_provider() creates new manager per call instead of reusing.
_DEFAULT_G3_PATH uses fragile Path(__file__).parents[3] relative resolution. Works in dev repo but would break in installed package. Acceptable since it's a dev/CLI tool with overridable default.
Mild scope creep: 'germlines rebuild' subcommand was added in commit 0300246b alongside the reference-generate-cli feature. Should have been a separate commit/feature.
sys.exit(1) usage in Click command and bare Exception catch. Consistent with existing codebase patterns but not ideal.

YAML-vs-CSV count inconsistency: test_yaml expects 14523 alleles (from YAML) but test_check_default_reference_df expects 4977 (from pre-built CSV). Correct for now, to be resolved when pre-built DB is regenerated.
New test file tests/unit/reference/test_auto_generation.py needs black formatting.
